title_zh: 京张续城：参与者量化预可研与条件性交接包
title_en: Jing-Zhang In Place: Quantified Participant Pre-feasibility and Conditional Handoff Packet
purpose: This participant-authored dossier completes a quantified, unpriced pre-feasibility package for future G1 external verification. It is not a carrier selection, field survey, appointment, safety case approval, procurement authorization, commissioning record, budget, funding commitment, or operating authorization.

participant_release_state.meaning: The participant-authored quantities, role-hour basis, relative sensitivities, dependency programme, role/competence routing, cadence, procurement path, and layered acceptance ledger are complete enough to be independently checked at G1.

truth_boundary.rule: Every external prerequisite remains HOLD_EXTERNAL until a future rights-holder, qualified professional, and field process provide applicable evidence.
